risks.title: Egg prices
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to significant fluctuations in egg prices. Average prices have varied substantially ($2,622 in 2023, $1,932 in 2024, $3,134 in 2025), directly impacting sales and profits.

risks.title: HPAI (Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza)
risks.score_rationale: The resurgence of HPAI in 2023 led to increased egg prices, but also losses for the company due to hen mortality. This could recur in the future.

risks.title: Input costs
risks.score_rationale: Feed costs for hens vary based on weather conditions and commodity market fluctuations. Costs decreased from $0.676 per dozen in 2023 to $0.490 in 2025, but could rise again.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, with numerous other egg producers. This may affect the company's sales and market share.

risks.title: Cage-free regulations and compliance
risks.score_rationale: Ten states have adopted minimum space or cage-free requirements. The DOJ litigation in July 2025 against California over cage-free laws adds regulatory uncertainty. Compliance requires significant capital investments ($248.4 million in approved projects).

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in litigation, including legal proceedings related to antitrust issues. This may affect the company's costs and reputation.

risks.title: Weather dependency and production conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to weather conditions, which can affect production, flock health, and sales. This may impact costs and profits.
